name: World Map
_comment: The world-map hub (MapHub), drawn as the evil cat (EvilMeowmeow.prefab), design V156. honeycomb: odd rows sit half a tile right. # wall, G green wall = a level not disclosed yet, P start. Portals unlock in the WorldMap order (Store, Pick Character, Tutorial, Level 1, Level 2, Level 3). Survival occupies the lower left-edge green hexagon (2, 14). Level 4 (the roam level, level_roam: the big map with the enemy pack) occupies the lower right-edge hexagon across from it (33, 14), and also opens after beating Level 3. Level 3 occupies the bottom-left tooth, the leftmost green hex of the lower teeth (13, 18). Survival opens after beating Level 3. The former Level 1 is now Tutorial. Finishing Tutorial reveals Level 1 (formerly Level 2). The Store opens after beating Level 2. Leaving the Store unseals Level 3; no purchase is required. All locked portals are solid green blocks and get a one-time spotlight when first unsealed. Pick Character and Level 1 open after Tutorial; Level 2 opens immediately after winning Level 1, with no earnings requirement. Tutorial and Level 1 are in the eyes, Level 2 is in the teeth. The two eyes are hollow, their outlines run green, rock, gap, rock round from the tip, with a miner in each (compete: they shoot at the player and time slows while the player stands still); a hook costs 1 HP; at 0 HP the player revives at Pick Character with full HP, and every won level refills it. still_time_scale = how slow time gets while standing still. The miners hunt only the player (hunt_player) and guard 4 one-time small gold in the eyes' top corners ($200, enough for the cheapest Store item). hook_wall_grace 0: the eye miners' hooks stop at the first rock they touch. hook_extend / hook_retract 9.5: the map cats' hooks, a little faster than Level 1's 8 (without them the Miner prefab's 17 / 22 made the map hooks about 2-3x faster). cooldown 1.6: the map cats wait 1.6 s after each shot before aiming again (the Miner prefab default is 0.8). These only touch the world map; level miners keep their own values. Level 5 (level_ring) is sealed in the cat's right ear, the ear on the right side of the map: the hollow is walled shut, including the neck at (22, 5), and the portal sits inside at (22, 4). The seal is ordinary map rock, so only Hulk's charge can smash a way in. The portal opens after beating Level 4.
